notes.title: Controls!
notes.content:
Lots of updates have rolled out since playtest has opened. This latest update tackles the fundamentals of the game. The original controls are now considered the "Pro Controls" and the standard control system has been simplified. Now you will "always drift" by default and you will need to enable "Pro Controls" to have the drift button which allows you control over when you drift and when you don't.

Go to the control settings to see more!

List of significant changes:

[list]
[*] Pro Controls
[*] Auto Accelerate
[*] Drift Assist
[*] Hard mode
[*] Difficulty balancing
[*] Shortened menu transition and startup times
[*] New translucent menus
[*] New Practice Area
[*] Revised Tutorial
[*] Revised menu controls for ease of use
[*] New music
[*] Optimizations
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Send your feedback into the forums!
